title: Hooray for Hollywood 35-Minute Helicopter Tour
blurb: Day or night, there is simply no better way to see the famous sights of Los Angeles than from a helicopter. Soar over the Hollywood Hills on this 35 minute tour and see Sunset Boulevard, Hollywood Boulevard, Beverly Hills, Grauman's Chinese Theatre, and the glistening Downtown skyline from a birds-eye perspective. Depart from Van Nuys Airport, where scenes from 'Casablanca' were shot. Admire the iconic Hollywood Sign as you get up close through panoramic helicopter windows.
